anika: Postdeploy: small-batch prefill synth spiking 5xxs on embed route, noticed ~2% failures for samples <50 tokens. Attaching quick logs. Deploy id: deploy-2026-03-10-canary-42. Hold or monitor?

deploy-bot: deploybot: Canary roll to 20% completed at 1782222200. Version rwinf/serve@v1.14.2. Canary health: failing checks on route /v1/embed-small-batch.

tom: Thanks. Can you paste a snippet of the error? Is this KV cache related or tokenizer? :thinking_face: 

anika: ```
2026-03-10T15:03:21Z ERROR embed:decoder.go:187 payload_size=37 status=502 upstream_err="kvcache-miss-oom"
stack="grpc: stream error: connection reset by peer"
```

kevin: kvcache-miss-oom? we've seen similar when quant table size changed. Who changed quant profile in this roll?

maya: I triggered a config tweak on quant profile two days ago for cpu-fallback tests. Reverting now to previous profile. Will post commit.

ops: Suggest pausing rollout, pin traffic back to v1.14.1 for small-batch route until we confirm. We can keep canary elsewhere.

anika: Agree. Can someone pin v1.14.1 for /v1/embed-small-batch? Deploy ID: deploy-2026-03-10-canary-42

deploy-bot: Action: traffic-pin executed by @tom -> pinned to rwinf/serve@v1.14.1 for route /v1/embed-small-batch at 1782222255. Canary paused.

srebot: Synth probe run at 1782222260: embed-small-batch p95=120ms -> previously 98ms, 5xx rate 0.03 (post-pin: 0.001). Logging saved to s3://redwood-inference/ops/synth/1782222260.log

tom: Good. Anika, can you confirm whether reverting quant profile removes failures? If so, coordinate with Maya for a safe roll and post release notes with the profile diff.

maya: Revert PR #4123 merged, rolling forward to canary-42 with quant-profile=v1.14.1-default. Re-deploying to canary subset (5%).

deploy-bot: Canary update: re-deploy to subset=5% started at 1782222285. Will run quick smoke: `/ops/smoke/run --routes=embed-small-batch --samples=500 --timeout=30s`

anika: Running smoke now. If green for 10m, increase to 50% then full. If any p95 reg > 2x or 5xx > 0.1% hold.

srebot: Smoke finished at 1782222300: samples=500, failures=0, p95=105ms. Marking green. Recommend staged ramp.

kevin: Thanks. After ramp, add regression test to nightly for small-batch embed to catch quant profile diffs.

tom: I'll update release notes: mention reverted quant profile, root cause hypothesis, pin timeline, and new nightly test. Also note no customer impact due to quick pin.

maya: Filed follow-up: ENG-1248 to add config guardrails. Assigning to kevin.

anika: Thanks all. Closing thread when ramp completes. :thumbsup:
